items.title: GRC Fundamentals
items.subtitle: Governance, risk and compliance from first principles
items.description: Builds the shared vocabulary every GRC professional needs: what governance, risk and compliance actually mean, how operating models are structured, who the accountable executives are, how the three lines divide work, how internal and external audit differ, and how policies, risk appetite and escalation translate intent into daily behaviour. By the end of the module a learner can read a governance pack, join a risk committee meeting with credibility, and explain to a business unit owner why a control gap is a governance issue and not just a paperwork problem.

items.title: Information Security Management System (ISMS)
items.subtitle: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 from clause 4 to certification readiness
items.description: Walks the whole ISO/IEC 27001:2022 standard clause by clause - context, leadership, risk assessment and treatment, competence and awareness, documented information, operational controls, monitoring and internal audit, management review, nonconformity and continual improvement - and then maps the 93 Annex A controls across the organisational, people, physical and technological themes. The module closes with the practical realities of certification: what a certification body actually tests, how Stage 1 and Stage 2 differ, and how a Statement of Applicability is built and maintained.

items.title: NIST Frameworks and Publications
items.subtitle: The US NIST toolkit for control catalogues, risk and resilience
items.description: Covers the NIST publications that enterprise GRC teams actually work with day to day: the SP 800-53 control catalogue and its baselines, the Risk Management Framework and its supporting publications, risk assessment, contingency planning, incident response, zero trust, secure software development, the Privacy Framework and AI RMF, and the Cybersecurity Framework 2.0 with its organisational profiles, tiers and gap assessment. Version and revision status is stated honestly, including where NIST has signalled that a publication is under revision.

items.title: The CISA Professional Domain
items.subtitle: ISACA's Certified Information Systems Auditor - the domain structure, restated in our own words
items.description: Describes the published structure of the ISACA CISA programme - five domains covering the information systems auditing process, governance and management of IT, IT acquisition and development, IT operations and business resilience, and protection of information assets - and works through what each domain actually asks a practitioner to do. Includes the audit lifecycle from universe and risk assessment to findings, root cause, reporting and follow-up, ITGC and application control design and operating effectiveness, and the practicalities of auditing cloud, third parties and emerging environments. No proprietary exam content is reproduced.

items.title: CISM Professional Domain
items.subtitle: Information security governance, risk, programme and incident management
items.description: Covers the four CISM-aligned domains as published by ISACA: information security governance, information risk management, information security program development and management, and information security incident management. Focuses on management decisions, programme design, metrics, stakeholder alignment and leadership judgement. Original learning content only.

items.title: Enterprise Risk Management
items.subtitle: ISO 31000, COSO ERM, risk registers and risk treatment
items.description: Covers enterprise risk management end to end: risk identification, analysis, evaluation, treatment, monitoring and reporting. Includes ISO 31000, COSO ERM, risk appetite, inherent vs residual risk, risk registers, heatmaps and key risk indicators.

items.title: Third-Party Risk Management
items.subtitle: Managing supplier and partner risk across the lifecycle
items.description: Covers third-party risk governance, tiering, due diligence, contracting, ongoing monitoring and secure exit.

items.title: Business Continuity Management
items.subtitle: Continuity, impact analysis and resilience planning
items.description: Introduces business continuity foundations, business impact analysis and continuity strategies and plans.

items.title: Cloud Security and Governance
items.subtitle: Secure adoption and operation of cloud services
items.description: Covers cloud governance, shared responsibility, identity, data, workload, monitoring and resilience considerations.

items.title: Privacy and Data Protection
items.subtitle: Privacy principles, lifecycle and accountability
items.description: Covers privacy governance, data lifecycle, rights, privacy by design, vendor/transfer considerations and incident handling.

items.title: Regulatory and Compliance Landscape
items.subtitle: Understanding and managing regulatory obligations
items.description: Explores regulatory obligations, scoping, monitoring, reporting, change management and multi-jurisdiction themes.

items.title: GRC Leadership and Influence
items.subtitle: Leading teams, stakeholders and executive outcomes
items.description: Develops leadership, communication, stakeholder management, decision-making and value delivery for GRC professionals.
